title: [grafana/grafana] Fix issue #130220: alerting empty label key validation
description:
GitHub issue: https://github.com/grafana/grafana/issues/130220

Scope: Fix Grafana alerting rule-group writes so legacy rules with empty label keys do not block unrelated edits in the same group.

Required deliverable:
- Open an upstream PR against grafana/grafana that fixes issue #130220.
- Scope validation to newly created or modified rules rather than unchanged rules echoed by whole-group writes.
- Preserve existing evaluation/notification behavior for legacy empty-label-key rules.
- Improve the rejection error so it identifies the affected rule by title or UID where possible.
- Add focused regression coverage for editing a valid sibling rule in a group containing a legacy empty label key.

Submission requirements:
- Provide the upstream PR URL.
- Provide the PR head commit hash.
- Include the test command(s) run and relevant output.
- In the PR body or a linked issue comment, mention OpenJobs listing a78b705e-847c-4152-a317-79b1819c905d / https://openjobs.bot/jobs/a78b705e-847c-4152-a317-79b1819c905d.
